**Finding: compliant** (rule ASSIGN, no redline proposed).

Section 24 satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

- **§ 24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or M&A/asset-sale successor without Vendor consent, on prompt written notice.
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct competitor of ours.
- **§ 24.3** — mutual reasonable-consent standard for other assignments; residual, not a restriction on our carve-out.
- **§ 24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, plus a cooperation obligation for successor administration.
- **§ 13.3** — licence transfer rights track permitted Section 24 assignments, so the carve-out is not undercut elsewhere.

No walk-away triggers (no blanket bar on our assignment, no Vendor change-of-control exit or re-pricing right). Nothing to flag.
